note: Not a function: the second byte of 'sub edi, 8' (0x003AEA33) inside Bink's audio decoder sub_003AE8C0 (the DUB Edition's sub_00378640, one function there). As a start it cut the decoder in two, the half with the epilogue lifted on its own: BinkDoFrame returned 0x8128 bytes of stack short, the movie function popped zeros into esi/edi, and the game never left state 1 (no picture, 2026-10-24).
